paragraphs: loveholidays’ Applied AI team sits within the Business IT & AI Operations function, providing the technical expertise, governance and operational ownership that enable intelligent automation to scale safely. The role sits in the Applied AI Centre of Excellence, reporting to the Lead Applied AI Engineer, and works closely with business verticals, engineering, security, vendors and stakeholders to build, administer and improve AI‑enabled systems and SaaS platforms that support customers and colleagues. Day‑to‑day responsibilities include administering a range of SaaS platforms and AI‑enabled services, configuring access, environments and integrations, and managing the lifecycle of those services. You also build and maintain applied and agentic AI workflows that connect models, tools, business data, APIs and SaaS systems, while monitoring service health, usage, cost and performance.

I have delivered production‑grade integrations that connect disparate systems through REST APIs, drawing on experience in fintech environments where reliable API communication is critical. In those projects I designed and implemented the full integration stack, handling authentication, request routing and error handling to ensure seamless data exchange. By configuring environments and managing access controls, I maintained secure, repeatable deployments that met strict operational standards. This hands‑on work aligns directly with loveholidays’ need for administering cloud‑based business systems, configuring user access and overseeing release management for SaaS platforms. My focus on robust API design and production reliability equips me to contribute to the team’s goal of improving automation and operational outcomes from day one.

In a recent evaluation effort I conducted roughly 65 tests across eight test files to assess the correctness and resilience of integrated components. Each test exercised the end‑to‑end flow of connected services, verifying that inputs from one system were correctly processed and returned by another. The systematic approach uncovered edge‑case failures and informed refinements that enhanced overall integration stability. This experience demonstrates my ability to perform thorough evaluation of integrations, a requirement highlighted for the role. By applying disciplined testing and documentation, I ensured that the integrations met performance expectations and could be reliably operated within a production environment.
